LanguageData.RecipeTweaker_SettingsDesc: Real-time in-game recipe editor for vanilla and all modded RecipeDefs. Customize ingredient lists, work amounts (crafting time), labels, or disable recipes completely.
LanguageData.RecipeTweaker_ResetAllConfirm: Are you sure you want to revert all custom recipe tweaks to vanilla defaults? This will erase all your saved recipe modifications.
LanguageData.RecipeTweaker_ResetAllSuccess: All recipes have been reset to vanilla defaults.
LanguageData.RecipeTweaker_HelpText: Tip: Changes made in the Recipe Editor take effect immediately and are saved automatically across game restarts. Work amount edits synchronize both recipe speed and item WorkToMake stat.
